description: Change one tool's permission and publish it to agents immediately. Takes the tool name or endpoint slug from octri_get_mcp_permissions. Fails with a conflict if a teammate published in between: read again and retry.

destructive.description: Whether a call can destroy or overwrite data.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional, falls back to the CLI's selected project.

name: octri_set_mcp_permission
